description: Read the solet's own deployment records. Use it to answer what is deployed now and since when, to list past deployments, or to re-read one record before changing it. Mode 'current' returns the newest deployment by deployed_at whose state is 'recorded' (zero or one row; a withdrawn row is skipped). Mode 'history' returns deployments newest first with withdrawn rows included, a page of 'limit' rows (default 20, maximum 100) and a 'next' token to pass as 'after' for the following page. Mode 'get' returns one row by deployment_id and needs that parameter. Every mode is scoped to solet_name. No side effects.
embedding_description: What is deployed right now and since when for this solet. List past deployments newest first, page through them, or look up one deployment by id. Read-only view of the deployment records.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Object with rows (list of deployment rows, each with deployment_id, solet_name, release_id, git_sha, deployed_at, trigger, state, version) and next (string token for the next history page, or null). Mode current returns zero or one row; mode get returns exactly one row.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: For current, state the release id, short sha and deployed_at, or say plainly that nothing is recorded. For history, one line per row with release, sha, time and state; mark withdrawn rows. If next is not null, say more pages exist.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Pass the row's version as expected_version to set_deployment_state if a change follows. Pass next as after to read the following page. Do not re-read immediately to confirm; one read is authoritative for the moment.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reading deployment records of one solet from the solet's own database through the state service
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: invalid_argument: mode is not current, history or get, mode get has no deployment_id, limit is outside 1..100, or after is not a next token from a previous page. unknown_deployment: mode get found no record with that id for that solet. state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound. The code is in data.error_code and prefixes the error text.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For invalid_argument, fix the named parameter; for after, restart from the first page. For unknown_deployment, read mode history to find the right id and check solet_name. For state_service_unavailable, wait for the solet to finish starting and retry once.
